title: Hearty Malaysian Haricot Bean Curry
description: A quick and flavorful Malaysian curry made with haricot beans and coconut cream, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This low-glycemic-friendly dish is cooked in individual mini cocottes for a fun and satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat the ghee or oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the curry powder and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cooked and fermented haricot beans, coconut cream, salt, and black pepper to the skillet.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 10 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
Ladle the curry into individual mini cocottes and serve hot.
Garnish with fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
